packages.vo_script: He was seconds from losing control at the furnace. One memory stopped him. Kagurabachi Chapter 129 pushes Kunishige to his physical and emotional limit as flames threaten to consume everything around him. Right as he's about to lose it, a flashback reveals why: an abusive father and his mother's death left him convinced he's unworthy of Chiaki. But his real motivation was never revenge -- it's protecting her that keeps him forging despite the risk. Just as his eyes seem ready to close, his memories shift to Chiaki, and he regains control. Chapter 130 releases August 30th. Is Chiaki actually Kunishige's hope, or his biggest weakness? Leave your take.
